intended_use: Candidate breast cancer screening model. Registered for evaluation only; it is not selectable for analysis until an administrator approves it against a local benchmark.
training_data: Proprietary vendor training data. MIAP has no access to the training set and does not retrain the model.
validation: Not benchmarked locally. Candidate status; no approval decision has been recorded.
limitations: Proprietary weights and licence; redistribution and local deployment require a vendor agreement.
May require remote code; MIAP refuses remote code unless the model is benchmarked and cached locally.
Not validated on Ugandan or local patients.
Cancer screening claims must be evaluated against the local pathway before approval.
ethical_notes: Visible in the library as a candidate only. No clinical use.
